verdict.rationale: Skyvern's docs say self-hosted Skyvern runs entirely on your infrastructure, with your own servers, browsers and LLM API keys. llms.txt describes it as open source, and a community user testing it was billed only on their own OpenAI key. Together this points to running it without a Skyvern cloud account. The SDK's default mode connects to a cloud Chromium instance, but that is the hosted option and does not contradict self-hosting. Missing for 10: explicit docs on running against a local browser on a developer's own machine (e.g. headful local Chromium or a local install guide), and hands-on corroboration of a fully local dev setup.
